title: Hosting Customer Credit on Restored Years of Domain Registrations
content:
## Benefit card: hosting customer credit on a redemption restore

**Product:** Domain Registrations. **Applies to:** the amount of a redemption restore billed on or after 1 December 2025.
**Records read:** the customer's Web Hosting Plans holdings — the plan whose primary domain is the restored domain, its status and its billing term.

The restored-year hosting credit, one of the restored-year credits, is USD 3.00 for each restored year where a Web Hosting Plans plan whose primary domain is this domain has status active and a billing term of 12 months or more, USD 1.50 for each restored year where such a plan has status active and a billing term of 1 month, and nothing otherwise.

| Web Hosting Plans plan for the restored domain | Credit per restored year |
|---|---|
| Status active, billing term 12 months or more | USD 3.00 |
| Status active, billing term 1 month | USD 1.50 |
| No plan with that primary domain in status active | Nothing |

The credit is counted once for each restored year of the restore. A plan in any status other than active, or a plan set up for a different primary domain, earns nothing on this restore.

*Hypothetical examples:* a restore of one restored year for a domain that is the primary domain of an active Harborline Pro plan on a 24-month term earns USD 3.00; the same restore with that plan on a 1-month term earns USD 1.50; with the plan suspended or cancelled, nothing is earned.
